SUMMARY & PURPOSE

Accessible modal dialog window with backdrop scrim, focus trapping, and header/footer slots.

WHEN IT WORKS (IDEAL FOR)
•
Focused multi-field forms or critical intermediate workflows
WHEN IT IS INAPPROPRIATE (AVOID FOR)
•
Small lightweight tooltips or non-blocking alerts
JOBS TO BE DONE
Trap focus inside modal until user explicitly confirms or closes
EXPECTED CONTENT REQUIREMENTS
Accessible label and appropriate semantic tokens
